title: Flying saucer observatory detection over Ottawa and the end of Project Magnet

tellings.quote: it happens a week later it happens on the 8th the thing comes flying over and I was talked to one of the guys who was in the building at the time and he said all the bells went off

plain: In 1954 Canada ran a small observatory near Ottawa to detect flying saucers, part of Project Magnet, a Canadian government study of the subject led by an engineer named Wilbert B. Smith. The UFO researcher Grant Cameron tells Michels that about a week after a warning, on the 8th, something flew over and "all the bells went off"; he says he spoke to a man who was in the building at the time. The title ties this event to the end of Project Magnet.
